description: Valid mono frames with six broken ones between them: codebook 12, a section past max_sfb, max_sfb 60 at 44100 Hz, a block that ends inside its spectral data, an escape sequence of nine leading ones, and predictor data in AAC LC. Each block's reading stops there.
findings: names codebook 12, which the specification reserves
has a section that ends at band 6, past max_sfb 4
gives max_sfb 60, more than the 49 scalefactor bands
runs past the end of its access unit
holds an escape sequence of more than 8 leading ones
sets predictor_data_present, which AAC LC does not define

skip.faad: faad2 stops at the first broken frame.
skip.decode: a damaged file, which decoders reject
skip.faad_trace: faad2 stops at the first broken frame.
